name: pixel-agents
description: Multi-agent pixel world rendered with Colyseus (authoritative server) + Phaser (client). A rewrite of pixel-agents.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:arcade && pnpm run build
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @pixel/desktop run build
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @pixel/desktop run build && pnpm --filter @pixel/desktop run dev
scripts.dist:desktop: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm --filter @pixel/desktop run dist
scripts.release: pnpm run version:gen && pnpm run build
scripts.docker:release: pnpm run docker:build && pnpm run docker:push
